Jharkhand Foundation Day: jharkhand bana lekin kyon adhure rah gae sapne? devendr nath mahto ne bataee hakikat
Jharkhand sthapna ke 26 sal pure ho chuke hain, lekin kya jin sapnon ke sath alag rajy ka gathan huaa tha, ve pure hue? aakhir vikas ke kin morchon par jharkhand pichhe rah gaya? sirph mantri aavas aur vidhanasbha bhavan banane ke lie jharkhand nahin bana tha... devendr nath mahto ne rajy ke vikas, yuvaon ke rojgar, shiksha aur mulbhut suvidhaon ko lekar bebaki se apni bat rakhi.
